name: has_high_qs_rank
description: Founder has at least one education with QS ranking 10 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_executive_role
description: Founder has held an executive role (e.g., President, CEO, Director) for at least 2 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(r.get('duration', '')) >= 2 for r in founder.get('jobs', [])) and any(role.lower() in ['president', 'ceo', 'director', 'co-founder', 'president & founder', 'founder, ceo'] for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_experience_in_industry
description: Founder has worked in the startup's industry for at least 2 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(r.get('duration', '')) >= 2 and r.get('industry', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_ipo_event
description: Founder has experienced an IPO event

name: has_acquisition_event
description: Founder has been involved in an acquisition

name: educations_in_top_qs
description: Founder has at least one education with QS ranking 50 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_leadership_experience
description: Founder has held a leadership role for at least 4 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(r.get('duration', '')) >= 4 for r in founder.get('jobs', [])) and any('lead' in r.get('role', '').lower() or 'president' in r.get('role', '').lower() or 'ceo' in r.get('role', '').lower() for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_education_in_science_or_engineering
description: Founder has an education degree in a science or engineering field
expression: lambda founder: any('science' in e.get('field', '').lower() or 'engineering' in e.get('field', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_experience_in_high_company_size
description: Founder has worked in a company with more than 1000 employees for at least 2 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(r.get('duration', '')) >= 2 and parse_company_size(r.get('company_size', '')) > 1000 for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_experience_in_top_qs
description: Founder has industry experience from a top QS ranked institution (rank 10 or better)
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', [])) and any(r.get('industry', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: multiple_educations
description: Founder has at least two different degrees
expression: lambda founder: len({e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []) if e.get('degree', '')}) >= 2

name: has_international_experience
description: Founder has worked in at least two countries or industries
expression: lambda founder: len({r.get('industry', '').lower() for r in founder.get('jobs', [])}) >= 2

name: has_startup_experience
description: Founder has held a role in a startup for at least 2 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(r.get('duration', '')) >= 2 and 'startup' in r.get('role', '').lower() for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_experience_in_biotech_or_medtech
description: Founder has worked in biotech or medical technology industries
expression: lambda founder: any(r.get('industry', '').lower() in ['biotechnology', 'medical equipment manufacturing', 'healthcare'] for r in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_focused_education
description: Founder has an education degree in their startup's industry field
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_advanced_education
description: Founder has at least a master's degree
expression: lambda founder: any('master' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'phd' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'doctorate' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_consulting_or_advisory_experience
description: Founder has experience in consulting or advisory roles for at least 2 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(r.get('duration', '')) >= 2 and 'consult' in r.get('role', '').lower() for r in founder.get('jobs', []))
